content: BTW Twitter is innovating in aways that it never has. People not staying on Twitter would have no way of knowing. Another reason why quitting Twitter is stupid, for software developers. Same as quitting Facebook was ten years ago when a lot of people did it. Great, now you have no idea what features your users are learning how to use. Eventually your software will be in a cul de sac. Where are you going to get fresh ideas from. Not using these systems would be like not listening to the Beatles in the 60s,. You would have missed all the popular music that followed.
